shots.camera_note: handheld arm's-length selfie framing, static, no cuts
shots.prompt_en: A young woman holds her phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a plain living room, speaking directly into the front camera with an excited expression the entire time, static unbroken framing, plain sofa and wall visible behind her, soft afternoon window light, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 一位年轻女性在简单的客厅里手持手机以自拍角度全程直视前置摄像头兴奋地说话，画面全程未切镜头，身后可见简单的沙发和墙面，午后柔和窗光。

visual_forms.prompt_en: A young woman holds her phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a plain living room, speaking directly into the front camera with an animated excited expression, static unbroken framing throughout, plain sofa and wall visible behind her, soft window light, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
visual_forms.prompt_zh: 一位年轻女性在简单客厅里手持手机以自拍角度取景，直视前置摄像头兴奋生动地说话，全程静止不切镜头，身后可见简单沙发和墙面，柔和窗光。

slot_template.template_en: A young woman holds her phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a plain {ROOM_TYPE}, speaking directly into the front camera with an {EXPRESSION} the entire time, static unbroken framing, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
slot_template.template_zh: 一位年轻女性在简单的{ROOM_TYPE}里手持手机以自拍角度取景，全程直视前置摄像头，带着{EXPRESSION}说话，画面静止不切镜头。

warnings: scene-detect 未检测到任何镜头切换，frames_analyzed 来自 interval-fill 按固定间隔抽样，不代表存在多个镜头
meta.note: 合成样例，用于 100x-video-reverse 的 schema/公理校验测试。这是真正的单镜边界情况（shots 恰好 1 条，全片无镜头切换），用来覆盖 schema 顶层 allOf if/then 新加的条件分支：只有 shots.length>=2 时才强制 cross_shot_analysis.invariants 非空，单镜视频没有任何跨镜头维度可比较，所以 invariants 和 varying_axes 在这里都合法地留空数组。与 example-05（2镜、中段跳切、non-empty invariants）互补：example-05 覆盖 allOf 的 then 分支（>=2镜必须有非空 invariants），本例覆盖 if 条件不成立时的默认情况（1镜，无需 invariants）。人物、场景均为虚构，不对应任何真实账号或视频。target_model=veo，单段 7.0s 在 8.0s 上限内。
